evidence_entries.notes: Stock early boot 0xFC020000..0xFC0201FF: reset entry 0xFC02000C, initial sp=0x4000 at 0xFC020014, vector table copy helper sub_fc02007e at 0xFC02007E, peripheral bus clock gate enable 0xC0242010 |= 1 at 0xFC02001A..0xFC020022, High RAM copy 0xFC020024..36, D-cache clean 0xFC02003C via sub_fc127a62, ATCM copy 0xFC020040..52, Low RAM copy 0xFC020054..66, Canon BSS zero loop 0xFC020068..78, branch to DryOS heap setup 0xFC02007A, and literal pool 0xFC0200B0..DF

Stock task_Startup (0xFC05B8FC) and startup task creator sub_fc05b962 (0xFC05B962): sub_fc05b962 calls sub_fc05ba68 (0xFC05B964), IsNormalCameraMode_FW (0xFC05B968), and power-on check sub_fc1284ac (0xFC05B96C); on zero return, calls sub_fc05ba56 (0xFC05BA56; writes GPIO 0x67=0x004C0003, cutting power) and hangs at 0xFC05B976. task_Startup calls sub_fc0d0150 (0xFC05B8FE), sub_fc05ba34 (0xFC05B902), sub_fc05bb94 (0xFC05B906), sub_fc418eec (0xFC05B90A), StartDiskboot (0xFC05B90E), sub_fc0bba02 (0xFC05B912), sub_fc0d046c (0xFC05B916), sub_fc05bcdc (0xFC05B91A), sub_fc05bb24 (0xFC05B91E), sub_fc418f2a (0xFC05B922), sub_fc090674 (0xFC05B926), sub_fc0d0472 (0xFC05B92A), sub_fc1283d2 (0xFC05B92E), sub_fc2a75f6 (0xFC05B932), sub_fc0d0488 (0xFC05B936), sub_fc127f24 (0xFC05B93A), sub_fc0bb76e (0xFC05B93E), sub_fc0d02de (0xFC05B942), sub_fc0bb9cc (0xFC05B946), sub_fc0bb72a (0xFC05B94A), sub_fc05bce0 (0xFC05B94E), sub_fc33319a (0xFC05B952), sub_fc0bb6fe (0xFC05B956), and branches to sub_fc0d0126 (0xFC05B95E)

IsNormalCameraMode_FW (0xFC079404..0xFC079410) called by sub_fc05b962 at 0xFC05B968: loads byte from ROM pointer 0xFDF20380; if byte is 0 returns 1 (normal camera mode), otherwise returns 0; return value is passed in r0 to sub_fc1284ac to govern button-hold supervision check

MPU Region 7 configuration helper sub_fc0d00b2 (0xFC0D00B2..0xFC0D00EA; configures CP15 RGNR=7, DRBAR=0, DRSR=9, DRACR=0x121, enables MPU bit 0 in SCTLR), stock firmware continuation entry sub_fc0d0126 at 0xFC0D0126, sub_fc0d0150 at 0xFC0D0150, and TurnOffE1_FW sequence 0xFC0D01EC..0xFC0D0206 (disables IRQ at 0xFC0D01F2, stops watchdog at 0xFC0D01F6, writes 0x004C0003 to GPIO 0x67 at 0xFC0D0202, and hangs at 0xFC0D0206)

GPIO write primitive sub_fc0d73c4 and read primitive sub_fc0d73d0: sub_fc0d73c4 maps pin index r0 to MMIO address 0xD20B0800 + (r0 * 4) and writes action value r1; pin 0x67 (103) maps to MMIO 0xD20B099C (power hold control); pin 33 maps to MMIO 0xD20B0884 (LED control). sub_fc0d73d0 reads GPIO pin state

Preparation for DISKBOOT payload handoff sub_fc0d9c9c (0xFC0D9C9C..0xFC0D9CCA): masks interrupts via blx 0xFC31BEFC (0xFC0D9CA2); invalidates D/I cache at 0x8000 via sub_fc41870c (0xFC0D9CAC); configures MPU region 7 via sub_fc135284 (0xFC0D9CB0); sets r0=0x40008000 (uncached destination), r1=src buffer, r2=size, r3=0x8001; loads copy trampoline pointer ip=*(0x4000) at 0xFC0D9CC4; restores callee-saved registers; jumps via bx ip (0xFC0D9CCA) into Low RAM trampoline which copies payload to 0x40008000 and branches to 0x8001

ARMv7-A cache and interrupt maintenance primitives: sub_fc127a00 (D-cache clean & invalidate all via set/way DCCISW + disable C bit in SCTLR), sub_fc127a46 (invalidate D-cache by MVA via DCIMVAC mcr p15,0,r0,c7,c6,1), sub_fc127a62 (clean D-cache via DCCMVAC or DCCSW), sub_fc127ab0 (clean & invalidate D-cache via DCCIMVAC if size < 16384 or DCCISW all sets/ways mcr p15,0,r2,c7,c14,2 if >= 16384), sub_fc127b08 (invalidate I-cache via ICIMVAU or ICIALLU mcr p15,0,r0,c7,c5,0 + branch predictor invalidate BPIALL mcr p15,0,r0,c7,c5,6 + isb sy), sub_fc127b3c (disable IRQ: mrs r1, CPSR; orr r1, #0x80; msr CPSR_fsxc, r1), sub_fc127b4e (restore IRQ), sub_fc127b6e (dsb sy), sub_fc127b74 (isb sy)

Stock power-on button check sub_fc1284ac (0xFC1284AC..0xFC12851A): takes IsNormalCameraMode_FW in r0; samples GPIO 0x97 (Power button, 0xFC1284BC), GPIO 0x98 (Playback button, 0xFC1284C8), GPIO 0x88 (WiFi button, 0xFC1284DA), and GPIO 0x02 (0xFC1284EC); if in normal mode and all button states are unasserted (0), branches to 0xFC12851A returning 0, triggering shutdown via sub_fc05ba56; if any button is pressed, returns 1. 0xFC128524..0xFC1285AA diagnostic logger

MPU configuration routines sub_fc135280 (branches to sub_fc0d0078) and sub_fc135284 (branches to sub_fc0d00b2 at 0xFC0D00B2; configures MPU region 7 for payload handoff), and MPU diagnostic queries sub_fc135288, sub_fc1352a2, sub_fc1352bc

ARM-mode interrupt disable and task dispatch veneers 0xFC31BEE0..0xFC31BF3F: sub_fc31befc at 0xFC31BEFC executes ldr pc, [pc, #-4] loading 0xBFE14FE7 (ATCM interrupt disable routine in Instruction TCM, branching to sub_fc127b3c); the path sets only CPSR.I (IRQ masked), while FIQ state (CPSR.F) is inherited from the caller (UNKNOWN).

Cache helper wrapper routines: sub_fc41870c at 0xFC41870C (called by handoff preparer sub_fc0d9c9c at 0xFC0D9CAC to invalidate range [0x8000, 0x8000+size]; calls sub_fc127a46 DCIMVAC and branches to sub_fc127b08 ICIALLU/BPIALL) and sub_fc418722 (inverted clean/invalidate wrapper in stock ROM)
